description: Gate A Priority 2 / Pillar 2 E2E COLREGS eval catalog: curated public-style JMAT/JTSB collision narratives with independent gold (Arts. 13–15). Offline Zero-Dataset; target balance overtaking 25 / head-on 25 / crossing 50. Issue #59.
attribution: Narrative fixtures stylized after public MLIT JMAT saiketsu and JTSB casualty report phrasing. Gold labels are founder-curated statutory determinations, independent of colregs_engine output.

cases.title: 紀伊水道横切衝突パターン（右舷給路）
cases.facts_text: 本船Ａは針路０３０度、速力約１２ノットで進行中、右舷前約４０度に相手船Ｂを視認した。相手船Ｂは針路３００度、速力約１０ノットで航行していた。両船は接近し衝突の危険が生じた。
